answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 3248 Country: Pakistan Title: Are muslim women can read kalima Tayaba in a loud voice on a funeral (Mayat) sent answer in the light of Holy Quran ahnd Hadith (sunnah)? Question: Are muslim women can read kalima Tayaba in a loud voice on a funeral (Mayat) sent answer in the light of Holy Quran ahnd Hadith (sunnah)? Answer ID: 3248 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 405/308=H) It is prohibited to recite kalimah loudly on this occasion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
